en: We've all been there. You push a seemingly small change to production and suddenly everything breaks. Usually fixing it involves panic, digging through logs and hot fixes. But what if you could just go back? Today I'm going to show you time travel in action. It's not science fiction. It's the fastest way to revert the state of your application to the exact moment before the crash. Let's jump into the demo. Now, let's look at how we implement this inside the ADK. code snippet on the left, we use the rewind async method. This essentially takes the runner and rolls the session back to a specific invocation ID or timestamp. When we do this, two important things happen. First, all session level resources are restored to that exact moment. And second, any new messages you send are processed as if they originated from that past timeline. It creates a seamless way to fork or retry conversations programmatically.
